notes:
Original full primary paper unavailable: DOI landing not accessible; CiteSeer PDF returned 404/timeout; Unpaywall and OpenAlex report no open-access location. Original statistics quoted secondarily in replication paper were not used. Supplied replication page locators appear to refer to a manuscript rather than the six-page published article. Requested d is not printed for this test; retained the printed t statistic without conversion. Original study did not use the BIDR according to the replication description, but original primary source remains unavailable.
Source follow-up: Published article title and DOI match the assigned original reference. Outcome mismatch: no BIDR self-deceptive enhancement (SDE) test is reported, so the alcohol-composite sample and statistics are not substituted. Original only; replication and narrative replication success were not examined.
